# fixture: big.LITTLE, core_id restarting at 0 in each 4-cpu cluster; captured with util-linux 2.39.3 lscpu --sysroot on a hand-made sysfs (with -y it reports cpus 0 and 4 as one core)
# The following is the parsable format, which can be fed to other
# programs. Each different item in every column has an unique ID
# starting usually from zero.

0,,0,0,Y
1,,0,1,Y
2,,0,2,Y
3,,0,3,Y
4,,0,4,Y
5,,0,5,Y
6,,0,6,Y
7,,0,7,Y
